title: AppFlow action enums need sparse reserved ordinal support
body: The lane is assigned action ids 70..79 while another lane owns 53..69. The generated AppFlowModel BuildEnum at SourceGenerator~/Transpiler/AppFlowModel.cs:409-416 derives ordinals from declaration order and ignores explicit enum constants, so adding the actions would silently emit 53..62 and collide. Add a declared sparse/reserved-range contract or an equivalent generator rule before material actions can be authored safely.

title: Generated SDF graph initializers must initialize appended socket fields
body: The pinned generated SdfOpCodes.g.h appends SdfGraphInputSocket.sourceLayerId and sourcePort but its generated aggregate initializers omit them. VIXEN's -Werror build then fails with missing-field-initializers; this lane had to add a consumer diagnostic suppression around the generated include. Emit complete initializers (or a generated designated-initializer form) so consumers do not need hand-written warning guards.

title: VIXEN codegen should vendor the refreshed VoxelDocument artifact
body: The pinned kernel generator produced the V5 VoxelDocument.g.h with layerIds, wires, bindings, and format 5 support, but the VIXEN CMake regeneration target did not refresh the tracked consumer header used by RecipeSimd. Recovery required running the documented kernel generator test and copying the generated artifact into VIXEN/libraries/SVO/include/Recipe/generated/VoxelDocument.g.h. Make the consumer target regenerate or validate this vendored artifact as part of the pinned repo target.

title: Kernel generator test target needs explicit runtime and pairing provisioning
body: The queued generator test first aborted because the host ICU package was unavailable; retrying with DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 then failed because UNDERTOW_ROOT was unset. A third queued run with both the invariant setting and UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow passed 1498/1498. Make the supported queued generator witness declare these prerequisites or provision them automatically.
